roles: One sentence describing the roles you want, e.g. 'early-career product manager, APM, AI PM, plus forward-deployed engineer / deployment strategist / solutions roles — junior/early-career, not senior/director'.
startup_types: One sentence describing the companies you want, e.g. 'AI, workflow automation, fintech, proptech, dev tools, B2B SaaS'.

_help.resume_file: Path to your resume (.pdf, .txt, or .md). setup_profile.py reads it to extract your real titles/skills. PDFs are sent to Claude directly — no extra library needed.
_help.locations: A role's location must contain one of these (lowercased) to pass the filter. Use [] for no location filter (any location).
_help.remote_ok: true also keeps roles whose location says 'remote'.
_help.roles: Plain English. Claude turns this + your resume into the title/seniority filters.
_help.startup_types: Plain English. Becomes the domain filter (jobs) and funding focus keywords.
_help.company_size: 'small' = early-stage rank first, 'large' = bigger first, 'any' = neutral.
_help.years_experience: Approx years; postings demanding far more get penalized.
_help.max_age_days: Job digest only: drop postings older than this many days (by the board's own posted date) and rank fresher ones higher. Set 0 to disable age filtering.
_help._usage: Fill this file in, then run:  python setup_profile.py  → writes profile.compiled.json, which both digests load automatically. Re-run whenever you edit this file or your resume.
